about.what: Curated list of Salish Sea marine terminals and facilities that ships service (oil and gas, refineries, fuel/bunkering, coal, chemicals, LNG, grain and other significant industrial bulk terminals). Plan approved by Josh 2026-09-27 (docs/OIL_GAS_INFRASTRUCTURE_SOURCES.md).
about.rules: Facts only. Every berth position cites its source row; every operator name cites the page that states it and the date checked (operator names in the sources are often stale and are never copied). Climate TRACE refinery ids (facility emissions) and ship-port ids (voyage emissions attributed to a port) are separate lists and are never shown as one another.
about.licences: USACE Docks: no use restrictions. WA Ecology: credit + link, no commercial or political use (accepted by Josh 2026-09-27). BC Ports and Terminals: Open Government Licence - British Columbia. GEM: CC BY 4.0. Climate TRACE: CC BY 4.0. OpenStreetMap-derived berth positions are NOT in this file: they are in salish-terminals-osm.json (ODbL 1.0).

berth_basis.ecology_dock: WA Ecology Class 1/3/4 facility dock point (OBJECTID; FacilityName re-checked on import)
berth_basis.bc_ports_terminals: BC Ports and Terminals point (SOURCE_DATA_ID; FACILITY_NAME re-checked on import)
berth_basis.gisis_facility: IMO GISIS ISPS declared port facility point (IMO Port Facility Number; row stored by ships:import-gisis). Used only where no USACE / Ecology / BC Ports and Terminals / OSM row exists (2026-09-28).

about.built: 2026-09-27 from small Salish-bbox pulls of each source (see docs/OIL_GAS_INFRASTRUCTURE_SOURCES.md, "Built (dev)"). Re-import: npm run ships:import-terminals.

terminals.name: Ferndale LPG export terminal wharf (former Intalco wharf, Cherry Point)
terminals.operator: ALA Energy (AltaGas); permit holder of record Petrogas West LLC
notes: USACE purpose: “Receipt and shipment of liquefied petroleum gas; and receipt of alumina.” The LPG part is current; the alumina part is history (commodities_history).
The wharf now serves only the LPG export terminal (propane and butane arriving by rail, loaded onto gas carriers).
terminals.operator_note: Whatcom County’s project page “ALA Energy Ferndale Terminal” (4100 Unick Road, Ferndale; applications CUP2024-00006, MPP2024-00002, SEPA2024-00052) names ALA Energy as the applicant. The County’s notice “County and Petrogas Reach Agreement on Permitting Compliance Pathway” names “Petrogas West LLC” and the “Petrogas Ferndale Terminal located in Cherry Point at 4100 Unick Road”: https://www.whatcomcounty.us/CivicSend/ViewMessage/message/195837 . Earthjustice (2026-04-01) calls the company “AltaGas (ALA Energy)”. AltaGas’s own page refuses scripted reads (HTTP 403). None of these sources states who owns the wharf itself (former Intalco wharf).

commodities_history.note: Out of date: USACE still lists “receipt of alumina”, which ended when the Intalco aluminium smelter closed (2020). Kept as history, not current use.

terminals.status_note: Earthjustice press release 2026-04-01: the terminal “receives, stores, and exports liquefied propane and butane”; the Whatcom County Hearing Examiner (2026-03-31) sent permits for 2 new and 31 previously unpermitted projects back to the County for new environmental review (AltaGas appealed to Skagit County Superior Court, May 2026: https://www.cascadiadaily.com/2026/may/21/altagas-appeal-asks-skagit-judge-to-approve-cherry-point-project-permits/). An advocacy group’s release, not a regulator: kept as the status source because no regulator page found states current operation.
